[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Equinix operates a very large global portfolio and this session found its own per-building pages under equinix.com/data-centers/ to be inconsistently populated: some individual IBX codes 404 entirely (confirmed fresh this session for DC17), and others that do load, such as DC7, checked fresh this session, still omit street address and square footage, deferring that detail to a downloadable specification sheet not reachable by this research pass. Given this, addresses in this batch rely on aggregator sourcing, preferring cases with independent multi source agreement, per this registrys standard source hierarchy. This specific row, DC7, per registry coordinates in Fairfax County, VA. The operators own DC7 page, refetched fresh this session, loads successfully and confirms N+1 power and N+1 cooling redundancy, but still does not display a street address or square footage directly, deferring to a downloadable specification sheet this research pass could not reach. DataCenterJournal, a dedicated single building listing, gives this facility as 7990 Science Applications Ct, Suite 1, Vienna, VA 22180. Vienna is itself an incorporated town within Fairfax County, so this address is consistent with, not contradictory to, the registrys existing city field. Only one aggregator was found giving this specific building its own street number this session.
